decision_basis: No critical, high or medium findings in the combined supplement above accepted original B. Both seed guards preserve resume ownership, and the existing Python tuple now persists self.prng_state without mutating live RNG state.

Independent actual save/inherited run/restore/strategy probes reproduce both defects on exact historical Git archives and pass on the pinned final candidate, with five resumed choices agreeing with saved uninterrupted controls and a separate random.Random reference.

Both interpreters pass 212 affected runtime cases, 22 fresh startup cases and 40 independent persistence/error cases. All 96 final-author startup records, hashes and durable streams pass the unchanged startup assertions; normal socket success is separated from deliberate containment.
Candidate and both historical B evidence reports remain unchanged; final combined C checkpoint-codec integration remains root/C ownership.

Fresh configured and no-seed runs, custom overrides without resumed_session, and all ordinary/central guards pass.

B-RESUME-01.proof: Eight independent 5b1c continuation cases fail per interpreter after one or 37 intrusive global draws, with genuine model/round/NumPy restore succeeding. Final candidate matches five uninterrupted selections and independent reference for ordinary/central x configured/no-seed x 0/1/37 draws x checkpoint before first choice/after two choices.
B-RESUME-01.save_effects: Actual save preserves live global Python, self.prng_state, context, full NumPy state including cached Gaussian, and CPU Torch state; repeated save after another global draw persists the identical selection tuple. Unrelated draws after resume also leave the next selection sequence correct.
B-RESUME-01.context: Context can be stale immediately after restore; the unchanged wrapper refreshes prng_state/current_round before actual strategy dispatch and preserves owned/context/global equality after selection.
B-RESUME-01.format_and_legacy: Same prng_state_<round>.pkl random-state tuple, pickle writer and reader. Independently generate actual old-writer checkpoint bundles on exact 5b1c, including diverged global state, then load them with final inherited run in both branches. Existing tuple remains readable with its recorded historical continuation.

checkpoint_errors.proof: Eight shipped broken-pickle/Safetensors cases plus ten independent missing-file and semantically invalid valid-pickle RNG cases per interpreter raise before launch, periodic creation or socket start. Existing missing-model OSError remains visible. No atomic generic-restore claim.

retained_b_runtime.proof: Accepted source outside base.py is byte-identical, as are all earlier tests/harnesses. The complete 212-case client/server/callback/smoke subset passes both versions, covering retained transport/session/timeout/recovery/PORT/S3/cleanup/aggregation/selection behavior. This is regression execution, not a new security-clean claim.
